semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user explicitly states a bounded desired outcome and deadline; the agent preserves it as a goal rather than reporting completion.

value.name: goal_outcome
value.text: launch the pilot to five clinics

required_summary_meanings: The user stated a goal to launch the pilot to five clinics by October 1.
The agent said the launch should not be treated as completed.

supported_if_authored: The user has a stated goal to launch the pilot to five clinics by October 1.

required_limitations: The year and timezone for October 1 are not stated.

supported_propositions: The user stated a pilot-launch goal covering five clinics.
The goal has an October 1 deadline.
The agent did not claim the launch was complete.
forbidden_propositions: The pilot launched to five clinics.
October 1 includes an unstated year or timezone.

evidence_spans.quote: Our goal is to launch the pilot to five clinics by October 1.
I will record that as the stated pilot goal, not as a completed launch.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user supplies a desired measurable release outcome and test condition, while the agent explicitly distinguishes the target from achieved performance.
required_summary_meanings: The user set a performance goal of p95 latency below 200 milliseconds under the documented load test.
The agent said the event does not establish that the target is already met.

supported_if_authored: The next release has a stated p95 latency goal below 200 milliseconds under the documented load test.

required_limitations: No current measurement or load-test result is supplied.

supported_propositions: The user stated a measurable latency goal for the next release.
The goal applies under the documented load test.
forbidden_propositions: Current p95 latency is below 200 milliseconds.
The release passed its load test.
The load-test procedure is supplied in this event.

evidence_spans.quote: I want the next release to keep p95 latency below 200 milliseconds under the documented load test.
That gives us a measurable performance goal; it does not show that the target is currently met.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The participants explicitly distinguish an outcome-level goal from one candidate implementation task.
required_summary_meanings: The user defined successful unaided setup by a new engineer as the goal.
Rewriting the install guide was identified only as one possible task.

supported_if_authored: The stated goal is unaided setup completion by a new engineer.

supported_propositions: Unaided setup completion is the desired outcome.
Rewriting the install guide is a possible means, not the goal itself.
forbidden_propositions: The install guide must be rewritten.
A new engineer completed setup unaided.
The guide is the only possible route to the goal.

evidence_spans.quote: The goal is for a new engineer to complete setup unaided; rewriting the install guide is only one possible task.
Understood: successful unaided setup is the outcome, and the guide rewrite is not itself the goal.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user expresses a desired future outcome while explicitly withholding a current-quarter commitment; a goal label must preserve that tentative status.
required_summary_meanings: The user expressed searchable archives as a tentative longer-term goal.
The user explicitly did not commit that scope for the current quarter.

supported_if_authored: Searchable archives are a tentative longer-term goal, not a current-quarter commitment.

required_limitations: No committed delivery period is established.

supported_propositions: The user would like the archive to become searchable eventually.
The user withheld a current-quarter scope commitment.
forbidden_propositions: Archive search is committed for this quarter.
Work on archive search has started.
The user rejected archive search permanently.

evidence_spans.quote: I would like to make the archive searchable eventually, but I am not committing to that scope this quarter.
I will treat searchable archives as a tentative longer-term goal, not a current-quarter commitment.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user defines a future goal that activates only if a measurable condition is met, and the agent keeps the condition unresolved.

value.name: activation_condition
value.text: pilot reaches eighty percent weekly use

required_summary_meanings: The user made expansion to the support team a goal conditional on eighty percent weekly pilot use.
The event does not establish that the usage threshold has been reached.

supported_if_authored: Expansion to the support team is a conditional future goal tied to eighty percent weekly pilot use.

required_limitations: The activation condition remains unresolved.

supported_propositions: The expansion goal depends on an eighty percent weekly-use threshold.
Threshold attainment is not supplied.
forbidden_propositions: The pilot reached eighty percent weekly use.
Expansion to the support team is active now.

evidence_spans.quote: If the pilot reaches eighty percent weekly use, our next goal will be expanding to the support team.
That expansion goal is conditional; this conversation does not establish that the usage threshold was reached.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user establishes a prioritized goal and explicitly excludes a tempting but unsupported success measure.
required_summary_meanings: The user made reliability the primary goal for the cycle.
The user explicitly excluded adding more features as the success measure.

supported_if_authored: Reliability is the stated primary goal for the current cycle.

required_limitations: The event does not define a quantitative reliability measure.

supported_propositions: Reliability is the primary cycle goal.
Feature count is not the success measure.
forbidden_propositions: The cycle has a feature-count goal.

evidence_spans.quote: Reliability is the primary goal for this cycle; adding more features is explicitly not the success measure.
I will preserve reliability as the goal and feature count as an excluded measure, not invent a feature target.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: A goal is explicitly reported, but its owner is the compliance team rather than the speaking user.

value.name: goal_outcome
value.text: finish the control mapping this month

required_summary_meanings: The user reported that the compliance team aims to finish control mapping this month.
The user explicitly did not adopt that goal personally.

supported_if_authored: The user reported a compliance-team goal to finish control mapping this month.

required_limitations: The month is relative to the event time and no timezone is stated.
The team's goal is reported by the user rather than directly stated by the team.

supported_propositions: The reported goal belongs to the compliance team.
The user is the reporter, not the stated goal owner.
forbidden_propositions: The user personally owns the control-mapping goal.
The exact calendar month is independently resolved.

evidence_spans.quote: The compliance team's goal is to finish the control mapping this month; I am reporting their goal, not adopting it personally.
I will attribute the goal to the compliance team and keep your role as reporter.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The agent proposes an outcome and the user explicitly adopts it, so the goal is jointly authored but user-approved.

value.name: goal_outcome
value.text: every imported record traceable to its source

acceptable_facets.value: adopt source traceability as the goal

required_summary_meanings: The agent proposed source traceability for every imported record.
The user explicitly adopted source traceability as the goal.

supported_if_authored: Source traceability for every imported record is an explicitly adopted goal.

supported_propositions: The agent proposed source traceability as the outcome.
The user explicitly adopted the proposed goal.
forbidden_propositions: Every imported record is currently traceable.
The agent unilaterally established the goal.

evidence_spans.quote: We need a clear outcome for this work.
How about making every imported record traceable to its source?
Yes, adopt source traceability as the goal.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user corrects an overbroad goal and supplies the intended outcome plus a preservation constraint within the observed event.
required_summary_meanings: The user corrected the goal to retiring JSONL as an authority while preserving archive access.
Replacing every database was explicitly rejected as the goal.

supported_if_authored: The corrected stated goal is to retire JSONL authority while preserving archive access.

required_limitations: No persisted prior goal record is supplied for a revision-ledger operation.

supported_propositions: The intended goal is retirement of JSONL authority.
Archive access must be preserved.
Replacing every database is not the goal.
forbidden_propositions: JSONL authority has already been retired.

evidence_spans.quote: No, the goal is not to replace every database. The goal is to retire the JSONL authority while preserving archive access.
I will record the corrected goal and retain the explicit archive-access constraint.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user states a goal with a relative deadline; the observation must retain the phrase without fabricating an absolute timestamp.
required_summary_meanings: The user stated a goal to have the migration plan ready by next Friday.
The agent said the relative deadline needs locale and timezone context for absolute resolution.

supported_if_authored: The user has a stated goal to prepare the migration plan by the referenced next Friday.

required_limitations: The absolute deadline is unresolved because locale and timezone are not supplied.

supported_propositions: The desired outcome is a ready migration plan.
The stated deadline is next Friday relative to the event.
forbidden_propositions: Next Friday corresponds to an unstated absolute date.
The deadline is midnight in the user's timezone.

evidence_spans.quote: My goal is to have the migration plan ready by next Friday.
I can record that goal, but next Friday needs locale and timezone context before becoming an absolute deadline.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user explicitly supplies a goal hierarchy, distinguishing the top-level outcome from supporting outcomes.
required_summary_meanings: The user defined a safe beta launch as the top-level goal.
Documentation and rollback rehearsal were identified as supporting outcomes rather than equal priorities.

supported_if_authored: A safe beta launch is the stated top-level goal, supported by documentation and rollback rehearsal.

supported_propositions: Safe beta launch is the top-level goal.
Documentation and rollback rehearsal are subordinate outcomes.
forbidden_propositions: The three outcomes have equal priority.
Documentation and rollback rehearsal are optional.

evidence_spans.quote: The top-level goal is a safe beta launch. Documentation and rollback rehearsal are supporting outcomes, not independent priorities.
I will preserve that hierarchy instead of flattening all three into equal goals.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user defines an explicit completion criterion while the agent prevents the criterion from being mistaken for an achieved result.

value.name: success_criterion
value.text: eight of ten test users finish onboarding without help

required_summary_meanings: The user defined goal achievement as eight of ten test users completing onboarding without help.
The event does not state that the criterion has been met.

supported_if_authored: The onboarding goal has a stated success criterion of eight of ten unaided completions.

required_limitations: No test result is present in the event.

supported_propositions: Eight of ten unaided completions is the stated success criterion.
No achieved result is supplied.

evidence_spans.quote: We will consider the onboarding goal achieved when eight of ten test users finish without help.
That defines the success criterion; it does not establish that eight users have finished.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user states a simplification goal together with three explicit non-loss constraints, all of which must remain attached to the observation.
required_summary_meanings: The user set a goal of simplifying the library.
Causal search, source hydration, and archive unpacking must be preserved.

supported_if_authored: Library simplification is a stated goal constrained by preserving causal search, source hydration, and archive unpacking.

required_limitations: No implementation mechanism or quantitative simplicity measure is specified.

supported_propositions: The desired outcome is a simpler library.
Three named capabilities must be preserved.
forbidden_propositions: Any named capability may be removed.
The library has already been simplified.
The user supplied a specific simplification design.

evidence_spans.quote: The goal is a simpler library without losing causal search, source hydration, or archive unpacking.
I will treat simplicity as the outcome and those three capabilities as must-preserve constraints.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user reports an explicit choice between alternatives and supplies the reason, while implementation remains unobserved.
required_summary_meanings: The user reported a decision to use PostgreSQL instead of JSONL for transactional revision chains.
The agent did not claim PostgreSQL was deployed.

supported_if_authored: The reported storage decision selects PostgreSQL over JSONL for transactional revision chains.

required_limitations: The event reports the decision but contains no implementation evidence.

supported_propositions: PostgreSQL was selected over JSONL.
Transactional revision chains were the stated rationale.

evidence_spans.quote: We decided to use PostgreSQL rather than JSONL because we need transactional revision chains.
I will record the choice and its stated rationale, not claim that PostgreSQL is already deployed.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user makes a current but explicitly provisional choice whose continued validity depends on future evidence.
required_summary_meanings: The user provisionally chose provider A.
The choice remains subject to review after Friday's cost report.

supported_if_authored: Provider A is the current provisional choice pending Friday's cost report.

required_limitations: The content and outcome of the future cost report are unknown.
The absolute date and timezone for Friday are not supplied.

supported_propositions: Provider A is the provisional choice.
The choice is not final before the cost report review.
forbidden_propositions: Provider A is the final provider.
Friday's cost report supports provider A.

evidence_spans.quote: For now, choose provider A, but the decision is provisional until Friday's cost report.
I will preserve provider A as the provisional choice and Friday's report as the unresolved review condition.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The explicit decision is to defer a choice until evidence arrives; no option is selected.
required_summary_meanings: The user reported a decision to defer vector-store selection until benchmark results are available.
No vector-store winner was established.

supported_if_authored: Vector-store selection is deferred pending benchmark results.

required_limitations: No benchmark result or future selection is supplied.

supported_propositions: The decision defers vector-store selection.
Benchmark availability is the stated prerequisite.

evidence_spans.quote: We decided not to select a vector store until the benchmark results are available.
That is a decision to defer selection, not evidence that any vector store won.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The event distinguishes an agent recommendation from the user's authoritative selection.
required_summary_meanings: The user selected local deployment for the pilot despite the agent's hosted recommendation.
The hosted option was not selected.

supported_if_authored: The user decided on local deployment for the pilot.

supported_propositions: Local deployment is the user's selected pilot option.
Hosted deployment was only the agent's recommendation.
forbidden_propositions: The agent made the final decision.

evidence_spans.quote: You recommended the hosted option, but I am deciding on the local deployment for this pilot.
Understood. Your decision is local deployment; my hosted recommendation was not the selected option.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user decides who has authority to choose but does not choose the rollout window itself.
required_summary_meanings: The user delegated the rollout-window decision to Maya.
No rollout window was selected in the event.

supported_if_authored: Maya was delegated authority to decide the rollout window.

required_limitations: Maya's acceptance and eventual decision are not observed.

supported_propositions: The user's decision was to delegate the rollout-window choice to Maya.
The rollout window remains unresolved.
forbidden_propositions: The user selected the rollout window.

evidence_spans.quote: Maya will decide the rollout window. I have decided only to delegate that choice to her.
I will record the delegation decision and leave the rollout window unresolved.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user reports a past group decision and cites meeting notes, but the notes themselves are not supplied as evidence.
required_summary_meanings: The user reported that the steering group decided the previous week to pause the integration.
The report was attributed to meeting notes that are not included.

supported_if_authored: The user reported a notes-based steering-group decision to pause the integration.

required_limitations: The decision is indirectly reported; the referenced meeting notes are unavailable.
Last week is relative to the event time.

supported_propositions: The user reported a steering-group decision to pause the integration.
Meeting notes were named as the report source.
forbidden_propositions: Core Memory independently verified the steering-group decision.
The meeting notes are present in the admissible evidence.

evidence_spans.quote: The steering group decided last week to pause the integration, according to the meeting notes.
I will preserve that as your notes-based report, not as independently verified committee action.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user corrects an earlier-mentioned alternative and states the current choice, while no persisted prior decision is available for a revision operation.
required_summary_meanings: The user stated PostgreSQL as the current shared-service decision after previously mentioning SQLite.
No prior persisted record was supplied for mutation.

supported_if_authored: PostgreSQL is the user's stated current database choice for the shared service.

required_limitations: No persisted prior decision artifact is supplied for revision-chain handling.

supported_propositions: The current stated choice is PostgreSQL for the shared service.
SQLite was an earlier mention, not the current choice.
forbidden_propositions: A prior SQLite decision record was superseded in storage.

evidence_spans.quote: I mentioned SQLite earlier, but the decision for the shared service is PostgreSQL.
I will capture PostgreSQL as the stated current choice without mutating any prior record that was not supplied here.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user establishes a complete conditional choice rule, but the condition's outcome is not observed.
required_summary_meanings: The user stated a decision rule selecting hosted storage if the vendor signs the data agreement and self-hosting otherwise.
The event does not establish which branch is active.

supported_if_authored: Storage deployment follows a stated conditional rule based on vendor signature of the data agreement.

required_limitations: The vendor-signature condition is unresolved.

supported_propositions: Hosted storage is the true branch of the decision rule.
Self-hosting is the false branch.
The active branch is unresolved.

evidence_spans.quote: We decided that if the vendor signs the data agreement, we will use hosted storage; otherwise we will self-host.
I will record the conditional decision rule and leave the active branch unknown.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user selects an option for a bounded trial and explicitly schedules reconsideration, so permanence would be unsupported.
required_summary_meanings: The user selected option B for a two-week trial.
The decision is intended to be revisited after the trial.

supported_if_authored: Option B is the selected two-week trial choice, subject to later review.

required_limitations: The trial start time and absolute review date are not stated.

supported_propositions: Option B was selected for a two-week trial.
The selection is reversible and scheduled for reconsideration.
forbidden_propositions: Option B is the permanent choice.

evidence_spans.quote: Let's use option B for a two-week trial and revisit the decision after the trial.
I will mark option B as a time-boxed, reversible choice rather than a permanent selection.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user makes an approval decision while explicitly withholding authorization for the consequential action.
required_summary_meanings: The user approved the rollout plan.
The user explicitly withheld deployment authorization pending a separate go-ahead.

supported_if_authored: The rollout plan is approved, while deployment remains unauthorized until a separate go-ahead.

supported_propositions: The rollout plan received approval.
Deployment is not authorized by this event.

evidence_spans.quote: I approve the rollout plan, but do not deploy anything until I send a separate go-ahead.
The plan is approved; deployment remains explicitly unauthorized in this event.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user reports both a rejected alternative and a release-bounded decision to retain current labels.
required_summary_meanings: The user reported a decision not to adopt the expanded taxonomy.
The current labels will be retained for this release.

supported_if_authored: The current labels are the selected option for this release, and the expanded taxonomy is rejected.

required_limitations: The decision is explicitly bounded to this release.

supported_propositions: The expanded taxonomy was rejected.
The current labels were selected for this release.
forbidden_propositions: The current labels are permanent for all future releases.

evidence_spans.quote: We decided not to adopt the expanded taxonomy and to keep the current labels for this release.
I will record the rejection and the bounded status-quo choice for this release.

semantic_expectations.label_rationale: The user resolves one part of the design while explicitly leaving a dependent legal question undecided.
required_summary_meanings: The user decided that the interface will use plain-language labels.
Legal wording remains unresolved pending counsel review.

supported_if_authored: Plain-language interface labels are decided, while legal wording remains pending counsel review.

required_limitations: The legal wording depends on an unobserved counsel review.

supported_propositions: Plain-language interface labels are the decided direction.
Legal wording is not yet decided.
forbidden_propositions: The final legal wording is plain language.

evidence_spans.quote: I have decided that the interface will use plain-language labels; the legal wording is still pending counsel review.
I will capture the interface-label decision and keep the legal wording unresolved.
